title: Novo 2C Starter Kit – 2ml
description:
SMOK NOVO 2C KIT

The SMOK NOVO 2C KIT features an internal 800mAh battery, capable of delivering power in the range of 5W to 30W. The kit comes with a SMOK NOVO 2X REPLACEMENT POD-0.8OHM, with a 2ml e-juice capacity and a convenient top filling system. The clear e-liquid window allows you to keep an eye on your juice level, while the draw-activated firing mechanism provides a simple and seamless vaping experience. The device is made of durable zinc-alloy construction and has a magnetic connection, the LED Indicator Light provides important information on the device’s battery life and operating status.

Features：
Battery Capacity: 800mAh
Input Voltage: 3.5V-4.2V
Resistance Range: 0.6ohm-2.5ohm
For MTL Vapers
Anti-Leak Construction
Plug-n-play coil installation
Supports Freebase and Nicotine Salt E-Liquid
2mL E-Liquid Capacity

Parameters:
Size: 95.5*24.5*14.5mm
Capacity: 2ml
Resistance: 0.8OHM
Battery: 800mah

Includes:
1 x SMOK NOVO 2C KIT Device (800mAh)
1 x SMOK NOVO 2X REPLACEMENT POD-0.8OHM
1 x Lanyard
1 x Type-C Cable
1 x User Manual
